candidate_architecture.scope: Two source-conditioned procedural meshes followed each 600 m cold-water centerline, one per bank. Collision was disabled and explicit tags denied geography, hydraulic, bathymetry, wet/dry, buoyancy, and raft-force authority.

first_bracket.verdict: Rejected because matched shoreline pixels were nearly unchanged while most of the bank-closeup delta occurred in open water.

final_bracket.verdict: Rejected because the pale rectangular shallow-water band remained and the intermediate shallow shelf introduced a continuous pale rail. The final submerged ramp reduced that rail but did not materially naturalize the water-land intersection.

candidate_architecture.material_experiment: Vertex alpha drove a river-local cool wet-bank tint, darker albedo, restrained roughness, and restrained specular only on the candidate meshes; the accepted source terrain wrote zero alpha. This graph and its regenerated packages were not retained.
candidate_architecture.authority_boundary: The experiment was presentation-only. It never owned Landscape collision, surveyed geography, bathymetry, cooked solver state, wet/dry masks, hydraulics, buoyancy, raft forces, score, or progression.

matched_evidence.method: Direct normalized-sRGB comparison at 1280x720. Luminance is Rec.709-weighted sRGB. changed2pct is the fraction of pixels whose maximum channel delta exceeds 0.02. edge08 is the fraction whose adjacent-pixel luminance-gradient magnitude exceeds 0.08.

bank_closeup.verdict: Most of the large image delta is a darker open-water state, not improved shoreline geometry. Bank-transition edge density slightly decreases and the pale rectangular shallow-water band remains.

breaking_water_side.verdict: The fixed rapid-side bank is visually and numerically almost unchanged; edge density slightly decreases, so the mesh does not clear the material-improvement gate.

validation.unreal_editor_build: SmokeEmIfYouGotEmEditor Mac Development passed after both geometry revisions
validation.filtered_chilko_generation: passed for the first and final brackets
validation.candidate_native_map_promotion_tests: not run after the visual rejection; promotion stopped before acceptance testing
validation.restoration: All candidate source, tracked generator output, runnable map changes, and terrain-material changes were restored before commit. Only rejection evidence and documentation remain.

external_archives.role: complete final tracked diff plus all untracked evidence before restoration

remaining_photoreal_defects: Chilko still shows a broad pale rectangular shallow-water band where the transmitting ribbon meets the far bank.
Futaleufu and Chilko bank breaklines remain too smooth at DEM scale for a convincing wet/dry intersection.
The correct next treatment needs water-coverage geometry or surveyed bank/bathymetry detail rather than another broad overlay sheet.
Foam remains streak-like and lacks connected entrained-air volume, spray, mist, and rock-contact plumes.
Terrain material frequency, vegetation and rock donors, ecology, geology, lighting, characters, equipment, and raft presentation remain below photoreal acceptance.
Measured seasonal hydraulics, target-platform performance, and human acceptance remain open.
required_external_acceptance_gates: Futaleufu and Chilko guide review of runnable lines, hazards, water levels, entries, exits, rescue routes, and scenario authenticity
geospatial review of exact stationing, horizontal and vertical datums, bank breaklines, higher-resolution terrain, rocks, and bathymetry
data-rights and publication review for every DEM, satellite, guide, photo, and derived asset used for production
hydraulic calibration and convergence approval against observed behavior across playable seasonal flow bands
environment-art, geology, ecology, photoreal water/VFX, raft, equipment, character, animation, and occlusion approval
desktop and VR target-hardware performance, collision, capsize, wrap, recovery, complete-run gameplay, accessibility, and release acceptance
